**The DuPont Analysis Tells the Story:**
- ROE = Net Margin × Asset Turnover × Equity Multiplier
- 8.5% = 11.7% × 0.14 × 5.18

The ROE is entirely driven by leverage (5.18x equity multiplier). Asset turnover of 0.14x means it takes 7+ years to turn over assets — this is a slow-moving balance sheet with massive debt. **If asset values decline even 10%, equity is wiped out by 50%+ given 5.18x leverage.**
